gloss: to lean against; to depend on

definitions.gloss: to lean against; to rest against
definitions.explanation: To support one's body by leaning against something.

definitions.gloss: to depend on; to rely on
definitions.explanation: To depend on someone for support or assistance.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}に{寄|よ}り{掛|か}かって{休|やす}む。
examples.english: To rest by leaning against the wall.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{彼|かれ}の{肩|かた}に{寄|よ}り{掛|か}かった。
{親|おや}に{寄|よ}り{掛|か}かってばかりいてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't just depend on your parents all the time.

notes:
{寄|よ}り{掛|か}かる has both physical (leaning against) and figurative (depending on) meanings.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
- {寄|よ}り{掛|か}かる (dictionary form)
- {寄|よ}り{掛|か}からない (negative)
- {寄|よ}り{掛|か}かった (past)
- {寄|よ}り{掛|か}かって (te-form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- もたれる: also means to lean against, often more casual
